profile:
## Jon

**Identity & work:** Former banker; lost his job on **19 Jan 2023** and pursued entrepreneurship. Runs/opened a dance studio, though finances were tenuous by **21 Jul 2023**; took a temporary job and sought investors.

**Dance & interests:** Loved dance since childhood; contemporary is his favorite style, also practices hip-hop. Dance is his escape, stress relief, self-expression and source of happiness. Performs, rehearses, teaches, mentors and organizes classes, workshops, one-to-one mentoring, competitions and performances. Wants to guide aspiring dancers and welcome people of all ages and backgrounds. Also goes to the gym, studies marketing/analytics, networks, and uses social media.

**Values/goals:** Persistent, optimistic and willing to take risks. Believes in learning from customers, tracking goals, confidence, networking and not giving up. Wants a supportive studio where dancers express themselves and grow. Ideal studio: by the water; values safe Marley flooring.

**Relationships:** Gina is a trusted, mutually supportive friend and collaborator. She encourages him and agreed to help create/manage social media content.

**Possessions/media mentioned:** Whiteboard, goal-tracking clipboard/notepad, laptop; dance photos/videos. No pets or family mentioned.

**Timeline:**  
- **2022:** His dance crew won first place locally.  
- **19–20 Jan 2023:** Lost banking job; planned a dance studio.  
- **Feb 2023:** Performed at a festival; prepared for a March competition; began running the studio.  
- **23 Mar:** Running the studio and motivated by students’ progress.  
- **Apr–May:** Expanded promotion, offered school workshops, planned a May competition, attended a fair, read *The Lean Startup*, sought investors.  
- **20 Jun:** Grand opening; attended networking events.  
- **Jul:** Learned marketing/analytics; networking produced investor leads; revised his plan, pitch and online platform; collaborated with Gina on promotion.

## Gina

**Identity & work:** Lost her DoorDash job in **Jan 2023**. Became an entrepreneur, launching an online clothing store by **16 Mar 2023**; also runs a clothing business/store and was accepted for a part-time fashion-design internship at an international company on **27 May**.

**Interests & activities:** Passionate about fashion trends, unique pieces, styling, design and creativity; combines fashion with her love of dance and may offer dance-inspired items. Dance—especially contemporary—is expressive, graceful, essential and her stress relief. Former competitor; attends classes and has a dance mentor. Travels: visited Rome, not Paris. Uses advertising, promotions, websites, social media, influencers and networking to grow her store.

**Values/goals:** Takes risks, values self-expression, resilience, customer relationships and supportive communities. Wants a distinctive, cozy, inviting shopping experience and a growing customer base. Her tattoo represents freedom, dancing without others’ opinions, following passions and expressing herself.

**Relationships:** Strongly supports Jon’s dance and business goals; offers practical marketing advice and collaborates on his social media. No family or pets mentioned.

**Possessions/media mentioned:** Personal black hoodie, limited-edition camouflage hoodie line, tattoo; clothing-store displays and website. No pets mentioned.

**Timeline:**  
- **Jan 2023:** Lost DoorDash job; began building her store.  
- **29 Jan–8 Feb:** Launched advertising; designed a cozy store; secured a wholesaler; partnered with a local artist.  
- **16 Mar:** Online store opened.  
- **Apr:** Ran promotions, increased sales and considered bloggers/influencers.  
- **10–27 May:** Interviewed successfully and accepted a fashion internship.  
- **Jun:** Created a styling presentation and limited-edition line.  
- **Jul:** Fashion editors noticed her; built a customer-order website; attended dance class with friends.
